subject: english
source: CISCE Curriculum for Primary Classes I-V (2016), official

covers: Take part in role play, skits and conversations
Retell a story with the right facts and descriptive details, in clear full sentences
Join small-group and class discussions and stay on the topic
Name the key ideas in a text read aloud
Ask and answer questions about what a speaker says, to clarify and learn more
Tell stories and recite poems aloud with expression
Use full sentences when asked for detail or clarification
Use new vocabulary to ask questions and give information
Interpret a picture by answering simple questions
Put pictures in order and explain how events follow on from each other
Describe characters and feelings in a passage, and how their actions move the story on
Read aloud and silently with understanding, and answer comprehension questions in writing
Retell and write stories, folktales and myths from different cultures
Take dictation of three- and four-letter words and sentences
Write 8 to 10 standalone lines on a given topic, such as a zoo visit or a favourite food
Write about personal experiences and real-life situations
Recognise nouns as naming words, verbs as action words, adjectives as describing words, 'and' and 'but' as joining words, and prepositions as position words, in context
Use common and proper nouns, and countable and uncountable nouns, correctly
Use capital letters, commas and question marks correctly
Use 'myself', 'ourselves', 'himself' and 'herself' correctly
Work out a word's meaning from its context
Use words and phrases suited to their age
Identify and use homophones, antonyms and synonyms
